subject: math
question: 设 $f(x, y)$ 在 $x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 1$ 上有连续的二阶偏导数， $f(0,0) = 0$ ， $f_x(0,0) = f_y(0,0) = 0$ ， $(f_{xx})^2 + 2(f_{xy})^2 + (f_{yy})^2 \leqslant M$ ，证明 $\left|\iint_{x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 1} f(x, y) \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y\right| \leqslant \frac{\pi \sqrt{M}}{4}$ .
answer: $$ \begin{array}{r l} \left| \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \right| & \leqslant \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} | f (x, y) | \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {M} \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {M} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^

steps.text:
分析 根据所给条件，容易想到将 $f(x,y)$ 先在点 $(0,0)$ 处做一阶泰勒展开，再做放大。

将函数 $f(x,y)$ 在 $(0,0)$ 处做一阶泰勒展开，有

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {f (x, y) = f (0, 0) + x f _ {x} (0, 0) + y f _ {y} (0, 0) + \frac {1}{2} [ x ^ {2} f _ {x x} (\theta x, \theta y) + 2 x y f _ {x y} (\theta x, \theta y) + y ^ {2} f _ {y y} (\theta x, \theta y) ]} \\ & {\qquad = \frac {1}{2} [ x ^ {2} f _ {x x} (\theta x, \theta y) + 2 x y f _ {x y} (\theta x, \theta y) + y ^ {2} f _ {y y} (\theta x, \theta y) ].} \end{array}
$$

应用柯西不等式，得

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\left[ x ^ {2} f _ {x x} (\theta x, \theta y) + 2 x y f _ {x y} (\theta x, \theta y) + y ^ {2} f _ {y y} (\theta x, \theta y) \right] ^ {2}} \\ & {= [ x ^ {2} \cdot f _ {x x} (\theta x, \theta y) + \sqrt {2} x y \cdot \sqrt {2} f _ {x y} (\theta x, \theta y) + y ^ {2} \cdot f _ {y y} (\theta x, \theta y) ] ^ {2}} \\ & {\leqslant (x ^ {4} + 2 x ^ {2} y ^ {2} + y ^ {4}) \cdot [ (f _ {x x} (\theta x, \theta y)) ^ {2} + 2 (f _ {x y} (\theta x, \theta y)) ^ {2} + (f _ {y y} (\theta x, \theta y)) ^ {2} ].} \end{array}
$$

于是

$$
\mid f (x, y) \mid \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \cdot \sqrt {\left(f _ {x x} (\theta x , \theta y)\right) ^ {2} + 2 \left(f _ {x x} (\theta x , \theta y)\right) ^ {2} + \left(f _ {y y} (\theta x , \theta y)\right) ^ {2}} \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {M} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right).
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \left| \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \right| & \leqslant \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} | f (x, y) | \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {M} \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {M} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {1} \rho^ {3} \mathrm{d} \rho = \frac {\pi \sqrt {M}}{4}. \end{array}
$$

solution.final_answer: $$ \begin{array}{r l} \left| \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \right| & \leqslant \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} | f (x, y) | \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {M} \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {M} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^
